reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:8dd8aa7b1af578eecff78a512ca4a479]] Great product! It’s fragrance, sulfate and paraben free. It’s also cruelty free (no animal testing) which is very important to me. It’s made in the USA. I tested it, it worked wonder. It doesn’t leave an oily film on your skin and it does remove your makeup!  Kept my face moisturized.

reviews.t: Feels like water, cleans like soap
reviews.x: I love micellar water for removing makeup because it feels just like you're wiping your face with water and yet it removes all of your makeup, including waterproof makeup! I squirt the micellar water on a cotton pad and wipe it all over my face. Be careful of your eye area because it will sting if you get it in your eye. The trick is to use a very tiny amount.  I've used several brands and this one is one of my favorites. It leaves absolutely no residue behind and it does not dry out your skin,

reviews.x: I started using micellar cleansing water because it's so gentle and simple to use - I had the bad habit of falling asleep with my make up on because I couldn't be bothered to mess with lotions, soaps, foams, etc. But micellar water is so gentle, you don't even need to wash it off - unless you buy this brand. It stings! It actually stings and dehydrates, as if it has alcohol in it - I have no idea what's going with this product (maybe I just ended up with a bad batch), but the experience of using

reviews.t: I really like it. It does a good job of cleansing ...
reviews.x: I bought this to cleanse my face in the morning to shorten my routine. So far, I really like it. It does a good job of cleansing my skin without overdrying it. It leaves my skin so soft that I feel like I don't need to apply moisturizer afterwards (but do for obvious reasons :)) I have not had any breakouts or other issues with my skin since using it. I have used it a handul of times to remove makeup at nighttime. I would say I wear a light amount of makeup, this took it off no problem (I had to

I LOVE this product!!! I can't believe how much easier my skin care regimen has gotten and my skin looks amazing. I'm 45 and take really good care of my skin to avoid looking my age and this stuff hits everything right on the head - cleansing, toning, moisturizing. Not to mention the convenience of being able to take great care of my skin no matter where I am - the gym, out camping, late nights etc. The witch hazel in it makes it unsuitable for eye makeup removal (it stings) but I have lash exte

reviews.t: Cleans pores better then my face wash!
reviews.x: Great cleansing water. Gets my pores clean way better then ordinary face wash. I did a test where I washed half my face with my face wash and then the other half with this Miceller cleansing water and then went over my entire face again with this cleanser, and guess what? My cotton ball showed make-up residue was still on my face on the side I had used the face wash on! The other side came out clean! Pretty impressed. I will buy again.

I've used 3-4 different brands of micellar water prior to buying this one. I've always liked it to remove eye makeup. But this one came with a warning to not soak your cotton ball to prevent it from going in your eyes. I found out why! It burns terribly!!! There are similar products on the market that are much better/gentler than this. Definitely won't be buying again!!!

I really wanted to like this however it definitely BURNS your eyes. I was super careful around the eye area (due to reading other reviews) and I ended up having to wash my eyes in water. I could hardly open them they burned so bad. Don't waste your money.

I love this new cleanser! I saw an article on it in In Style Magazine and thought I should try it. It is very light and takes the dirt off my face very gently.  So far it works really well and I'll be adding it to my daily skin care routine.

I first discovered this brand when I was looking for an Indian clay mask, and theirs is truly amazing. They recently came out with this micellar water, which is all the rage right now. What I've noticed that sets their product apart from others is that it contains witch hazel. Witch hazel is very calming to the skin. However, be aware that it does contain a small amount of alcohol. I really like this product as I have sensitive skin, and have found finding a cleanser that doesn't burn or irritate my skin rather difficult. With using Micellar Cleansing Water My face feels cleaner and more refreshed without the burning or tight feeling that I have experienced using other products. I try to avoid chemicals, synthetic fragrances and carcinogens. As for my skin, it is usually dry and sensitive. It is hard for me to find facial products that cleanse and moisturize, not leaving my skin dried out or breaking out more. reviews.t: Looks and feels like a refreshing splash of pure, clean water, but removes makeup! What????  I love this!
reviews.x: What’s not to love here? No parabens, no sulfates, no chemicals. I don’t really understand how it works, but this product that feels like a refreshing splash of pure water removes makeup and cleanses. I really love it. I think the world has fallen in love with Micellar Water, and it’s understandable. My only complaint is that I didn’t have it years ago. This brand is wonderful. It’s a good price for a good, clear, pure product. I would happily buy it again and I’m sure I will. The company stands

reviews.t: Took off my Mascara & Lancome 24 hr foundation in a flash!
reviews.x: I was excited to try this gentle product for make up removing but wasn't sure if it would do the trick for my Lancome 24 hour wear make up and long stay mascara that I use for work.  Most of the time, with the exception of an expensive department store brand, make up removers require multiple applications to get all of my make up off, especially my mascara and leave an oily residue that requires that I wash my face after the fact.  Not with this cleansing water!  I've attached a photo of the tis

So...I'm going to give this 3 stars although I am writing this review through blurry tears......lol Just kidding but seriously..... DO NOT get even the smallest drop of this in your eye! Omg it stings! The product, other than that, does pretty ok. My main use was intended for eye makeup removal and I do use it for that but I have gotten VERY good at not getting any in my eye. It does kind of "raccoon" your mascara a little but overall it's better than water and soap... I give it 3 stars

This is a new product from Pure Bliss. I have their excellent Bentonite Clay...so I decided to give this a try also. I love it. It feels great when I smooth it on with a cotton ball after washing my face. It makes the skin feel extra clean, and leaves it feeling soft and refreshed. I love the fact that it is alcohol and fragrance free. That's great for those of us with sensitive skin. This company has yet to let me down. I highly recommend the Micellar Cleansing Water. Excellent product!

reviews.t: The packaging does a good job of stressing to use only what's needed (i
reviews.x: Maybe my skin just needs more time to adjust, but this micellar water stings much more than I'm used to. The packaging does a good job of stressing to use only what's needed (i.e. cotton pads should not be dripping wet) but even then, this stuff is hard to use around my eyes. It. Stings. So. Much. It does do a great job of removing make-up and cleans my face. I'm just not used to the sting. Hoping it clears up soon.

Great product! Love how it makes my face feel clean and refreshed. I don't use makeup a lot so I never thought of buying cleansing products. However, my face still gets oily at the end of the day and needs a wash. I've been using this product for a week now and am amazed how great it works. My face is soft, clean, and even my pores are less noticable. Definitly a favorite!

I really liked this face cleaner.  It is a bit bubbly when you put it on your skin but takes off all makeup and dirt.  It didn't leave my skin feeling sticky or coated either. And it didn't dry out my skin. Very effective in that It even removed waterproof eye makeup.  Just be careful to not get it in your eyes or it will burn.  Super great that it is paraben free!

Such a good cleanser! As a test i washed my face with my usual cleanser and then I went over it again with the miscellar water on a cotton pad and so much more makeup came off! It really gets your face clean without drying it out or being harsh. It works so well and you get so much for such a small price! I will keep buying.

reviews.t: This product does a very good job of cleansing
reviews.x: I chose Pure Bliss because using cruelty-free products is very important to me.  I've used this for about a week.  This product does a very good job of cleansing, but does leave my sensitive skin feeling a little dry afterward (but not enough to be a problem or to stop me from using it - I would order this again).

reviews.t: Love that it's light and removes everything
reviews.x: This works wonders! Love that it's light and removes everything. I have eyelash extensions so I can't vigorously scrub my face. Other cleaners leave me feeling like I have a layer of product on. This feels just like I used soap and water and have no product on my skin!!

I PUT THIS IN MY CRISPER AND THIS MORNING IT WAS SO REFRESHING!  I USED A COSMETICS PAD AND WIPED MY FACE WITH IT BORE APPLYING RETINOL AND IT WAS SUCH A GREAT FEELING,  COOL, CRISP, CLEAN.  I LOVED IT!  I REC'D THIS AT A DISCOUNT IN EXCHANGE FOR MY HONEST REVIEW.

claims.text: Many reviewers find it effective at cleansing and removing makeup, including waterproof makeup, and say it leaves skin soft without over-drying.
Several reviewers praise its gentle, water-like feel and suitability for sensitive skin.
A notable number of reviewers report that it burns or stings the eyes.
Reviewers appreciate that it is free of fragrance, sulfates, parabens, and is cruelty-free.
Some reviewers highlight convenience and its fit into a simplified skincare routine.
